title: Italian Pan-Seared Chicken with Rocket
description: A flavorful chicken dish with a rich Italian twist, served with a peppery rocket salad.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the skillet and sear for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chopped rocket to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until wilted.
Slice the cooked chicken breast and serve with the rocket salad.
